hook.en: A tutor who teaches in March but is paid in April can show the fee in March or in April. The basis of accounting decides which.
hook.kn: ಮಾರ್ಚ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಠ ಮಾಡಿ ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕ ಅದನ್ನು ಯಾವ ತಿಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿಸಬೇಕು? ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಆಧಾರ ಇದನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Compare double entry and single entry systems

narration.en: A tutor who teaches in March but is paid in April can show the fee in March or in April. The basis of accounting decides which.
narration.kn: ಮಾರ್ಚ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಠ ಮಾಡಿ ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕ ಅದನ್ನು ಯಾವ ತಿಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿಸಬೇಕು? ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಆಧಾರ ಇದನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Under the double entry system both aspects of every transaction are recorded, debit and credit, so the arithmetical accuracy can be checked with a trial balance and a true profit and financial position can be found. The single entry system records only some transactions, usually cash and personal accounts; it is incomplete and unscientific, and is used by some small traders.
body.kn: ದ್ವಿಮುಖ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಎರಡೂ ಮುಖಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಏಕಮುಖ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ಅಪೂರ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ.

points.en: Double entry: complete, scientific, trial balance possible
Single entry: incomplete, used by small traders

narration.en: Under the double entry system both aspects of every transaction are recorded, debit and credit, so the arithmetical accuracy can be checked with a trial balance and a true profit and financial position can be found. The single entry system records only some transactions, usually cash and personal accounts; it is incomplete and unscientific, and is used by some small traders.
narration.kn: ದ್ವಿಮುಖ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಎರಡೂ ಮುಖಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಏಕಮುಖ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ಅಪೂರ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ.

body.en: Under the cash basis, revenue and expenses are recorded only when cash is received or paid. Under the accrual basis, revenue is recorded when earned and expenses when incurred, whether or not cash has moved, so outstanding and prepaid items are recognised. The accrual basis follows the matching concept and is compulsory for companies under the Companies Act, 2013.
body.kn: ನಗದು ಆಧಾರ: ಹಣ ಬಂದಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ಕೊಟ್ಟಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ದಾಖಲೆ. ಸಂಚಿತ ಆಧಾರ: ಗಳಿಸಿದಾಗ ಮತ್ತು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಉಂಟಾದಾಗ ದಾಖಲೆ. ಕಂಪನಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಚಿತ ಆಧಾರ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ.

points.en: Cash basis: simple, used by doctors, lawyers and small firms
Accrual basis: true profit, required for companies

narration.en: Under the cash basis, revenue and expenses are recorded only when cash is received or paid. Under the accrual basis, revenue is recorded when earned and expenses when incurred, whether or not cash has moved, so outstanding and prepaid items are recognised. The accrual basis follows the matching concept and is compulsory for companies under the Companies Act, 2013.
narration.kn: ನಗದು ಆಧಾರ: ಹಣ ಬಂದಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ಕೊಟ್ಟಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ದಾಖಲೆ. ಸಂಚಿತ ಆಧಾರ: ಗಳಿಸಿದಾಗ ಮತ್ತು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಉಂಟಾದಾಗ ದಾಖಲೆ. ಕಂಪನಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಚಿತ ಆಧಾರ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ.

problem.en: In 2024-25 a firm made sales of ₹5,00,000 and received ₹4,20,000 in cash. Expenses incurred were ₹3,10,000, of which ₹2,90,000 was paid. Find the profit under the cash basis and the accrual basis.

steps.en: Cash basis profit = cash received − cash paid = ₹4,20,000 − ₹2,90,000 = ₹1,30,000.
Accrual basis profit = revenue earned − expenses incurred = ₹5,00,000 − ₹3,10,000 = ₹1,90,000.
The difference of ₹60,000 = ₹80,000 still to be received − ₹20,000 still to be paid.

narration.en: Let us work this out step by step. In 2024-25 a firm made sales of ₹5,00,000 and received ₹4,20,000 in cash. Expenses incurred were ₹3,10,000, of which ₹2,90,000 was paid. Find the profit under the cash basis and the accrual basis.

points.en: Accrual basis records revenue when earned and expenses when incurred.

homework.en: Distinguish between the cash basis and the accrual basis (any three points).

narration.en: Recap. Double entry records both aspects; single entry is incomplete. Cash basis records only receipts and payments. Accrual basis records revenue when earned and expenses when incurred.
